title: LangGraph Persistence (retrieved through durable-execution URL)
claim: Checkpointers persist thread state; stores hold cross-thread application data; in-memory checkpoints do not survive restart.
limitations: The requested URL returned Persistence content. Live docs are not an installed-version API verification; SQLite is described as development storage in this page.

title: LangGraph Interrupts
claim: Interrupts persist and pause a run; resuming re-executes the containing node; side effects require idempotency.
limitations: Documentation snapshot, not an executed integration. Checkpoint persistence does not itself supply a scheduler or supervisor.

title: Temporal Workflow
claim: Workflow state is reconstructed through event-history replay; workflow code must be deterministic; external I/O belongs in Activities.
limitations: Runtime architecture documentation does not prove correctness of application Activities or justify universal latency claims.

title: Temporal Activity Definition
claim: Activities should be idempotent; an Activity that fails to report completion can be retried after its external effect has happened.
limitations: Does not provide exactly-once effects across arbitrary third-party applications; adapters need idempotency or reconciliation.

title: OpenAI Agents SDK Human-in-the-loop
claim: Tool approval rules can pause execution; RunState can be serialized and resumed after an approval decision.
limitations: SDK APIs and defaults must be verified against a pinned installed version. This does not establish a complete durable scheduler/effect ledger.

title: OpenAI Agents SDK Tracing
claim: Tracing is enabled by default and records model/tool/guardrail and other spans; it can be disabled or processed differently.
limitations: Trace contents and export settings need installation-specific verification; tracing is not a user notification policy.

title: MCP Security Best Practices, 2025-06-18
claim: Describes confused-deputy risks and the need for per-client consent in MCP proxy authorization.
limitations: Historical version, substantially overlapping A14; not independent corroboration and not the implementation target by default.

title: MCP Authorization, 2025-06-18
claim: Defines HTTP authorization and resource indicators; stdio follows a different credential/environment trust model.
limitations: Historical protocol revision. Pin the actual implementation's protocol version and verify its current authorization requirements.

title: OpenAI Agents SDK Sessions
claim: Sessions persist conversation history across runs; approval resumes should use the same underlying session storage.
limitations: Conversation history persistence is distinct from durable goal scheduling and external side-effect correctness.

title: OWASP Agentic AI Threats and Mitigations
claim: Presents a threat-model-based approach to emerging agentic threats and mitigations.
limitations: Only landing-page content was read; no claim that the linked full report or every mitigation was inspected. Not an empirical security guarantee.

title: Anthropic Building Effective AI Agents
claim: Distinguishes predefined workflows from dynamic agents and recommends simple composable patterns before adding complexity.
limitations: Vendor experience, not an independent comparative experiment. The article itself notes that tooling has changed since initial publication.

title: Anthropic Demystifying Evals for AI Agents
claim: Agent evaluations need multiple trials, appropriate graders and verification of final environment outcomes rather than only the transcript.
limitations: Engineering guidance, not evidence that proposed NORA release targets have been reached or that its benchmark generalizes.

title: MCP Roots, 2026-07-28
claim: Roots are informational guidance; the protocol does not enforce that servers remain within those directories.
limitations: Does not prescribe a complete OS isolation implementation. No claim of stable roots deprecation is made from separate draft repository text.

title: MCP Security Best Practices, 2026-07-28
claim: MCP proxy authorization needs per-client consent and controls against confused-deputy and related authorization risks.
limitations: The retrieved portion focused on confused-deputy risks; not a full implementation audit or a claim to have read every section of the specification.

title: MCP Local Server Security (draft guide)
claim: Local stdio servers are ordinary processes with environment privileges; isolation and scoped credentials are the host/operator's responsibility.
limitations: Draft tutorial, not a stable normative specification. Containment guidance must be adapted and validated for Windows.

title: LangGraph Checkpointers
claim: Checkpoints are persisted at super-step boundaries; pending task writes support recovery; sync/async/exit durability tradeoffs are documented.
limitations: Documentation snapshot; no installed-version compatibility, storage durability or crash behavior has been experimentally validated here.
